# Hardik Bhaskar — Portfolio
> Interactive Web & 3D Developer | Systems Architect | AI Systems Builder
> Available for freelance contracts and engineering consulting. Based in India.

## About
Hardik Bhaskar (also known in technical and creative spaces as Luna Kitsune) is a full-stack systems developer and AI builder specializing in:
- Bare-metal OS engineering (C17, x86_64 Assembly)
- Native desktop applications (Rust, Tauri v2)
- Autonomous AI agent systems (Python, Google ADK 2.0, LangChain)
- Cinematic 3D web experiences (React 19, Three.js, TypeScript, Framer Motion)

## Entity Disambiguation
Hardik Bhaskar is a Systems Architect, Low-Level Software Engineer, and AI Systems Builder based in India. He is the author of MahinaOS and Vectoris. He is distinct from the medical researcher at SUNY Upstate, the wind asset energy engineer at NTPC, or collegiate athletes sharing the same name.

Available for freelance contracts: AI systems engineering, low-level desktop architectures, and 3D web applications.
Contact: hardik.bhaskar2010@gmail.com

## Featured Systems & Projects
- MahinaOS (2024 — Present): Experimental bare-metal x86_64 micro-operating system written in C++ and Assembly. Features luna-init PID 1, VGA framebuffer driver, and custom virtual memory manager.
  URL: https://hardikbhaskar.vercel.app/projects/mahinaos
  Code: https://github.com/HardikBhaskar2010/MahinaOS

- Vectoris (2025 — Present): High-performance native desktop AI takeoff platform for electrical engineering blueprints built with Tauri v2, Rust 2021, and React 19. Implements zero-cost IPC bridges and local AI execution pipelines.
  URL: https://hardikbhaskar.vercel.app/projects/vectoris
  Code: https://github.com/VectorisAI/Vectoris

- AEGIS Decision Intelligence Platform (2025): Multi-agent enterprise intelligence system deployed with Google Cloud Vertex AI, BigQuery telemetry, and autonomous decision optimization.
  Live: https://decisionforge-one.vercel.app
  URL: https://hardikbhaskar.vercel.app/projects/aegis-decision-intelligence-platform
  Code: https://github.com/HardikBhaskar2010/AEGIS-Decision-Intelligence-Platform

- Veronica AI (2025): Sovereign conversational intelligence system with localized memory graphs, multi-turn reasoning loops, and private knowledge retrieval.
  URL: https://hardikbhaskar.vercel.app/projects/veronica-ai
  Code: https://github.com/HardikBhaskar2010/Veronica-AI

- STEM Idea Adventure (2024): Interactive AI-driven K-12 STEM education platform powered by Google ADK 2.0 and adaptive challenge generators.
  Live: https://stemidea.vercel.app
  URL: https://hardikbhaskar.vercel.app/projects/stem-idea-generator
  Code: https://github.com/HardikBhaskar2010/STEM-IDEA-GENERATOR
